data.desc: Peoples Bancorp Inc. ('Peoples', NASDAQ: PEBO) is a diversified financial services holding company and makes available a complete line of banking, trust and investment, insurance and specialty financing solutions through its subsidiaries. Headquartered in Marietta, Ohio, since 1902, Peoples has established a heritage of financial stability, growth and community impact. Peoples had $9.5 billion in total assets as of June 30, 2026, and 144 locations, including 127 full-service bank branches in Ohio, West Virginia, Kentucky, Virginia, Washington, D.C., and Maryland. Peoples' vision is to be the Best Community Bank in America. Peoples is a member of the Russell 3000 index of United States publicly-traded companies.
